name: react-starter
description: Complete setup for React development. Includes the react-generate-tests skill (plus its React testing rule and the react-code-reviewer agent as automatically resolved deps). With sigil add, also installs the Filesystem MCP, config-file protection, and common dev-tool permissions. As plugins, add mcp-filesystem, hook-protect-config and hook-reviewer-bash-guard; the permissions need sigil add.
